title: Best Autofarm Script GUI BETA Auto Quest and More
features:
🐝 **Bee Swarm Simulator – Ronix Script Features**

### 🌾 Farming

* **Auto Farm**

* Farms selected flower fields automatically
* Smart movement using **Tween / CFrame travel**
* **Field Selection**

* Multi-select supported (choose multiple fields)
* Randomized movement inside fields to avoid detection
* **Auto Harvest**

* Automatically collects pollen
* **Auto Convert Honey**

* Detects full capacity
* Returns to hive and converts pollen to honey
* **Tween Speed Control**

* Adjustable movement speed (10–120)
* **Tween Modes**

* **Linear** – straight path movement
* **Orbital** – smooth curved movement (Bezier-based)

### 🎯 Quest Automation

* **Auto Complete Quests**
* **NPC Selector**

* Choose which NPCs to accept quests from
* **Smart Quest Detection**

* Only claims quests when NPC is available
* **Fully Automated Dialogue**

* Handles all NPC UI interactions automatically

### 🧠 Movement & Character

* **Advanced Move Controller**

* Physics-safe movement
* Velocity locking to prevent flinging
* **Noclip**

* Enabled automatically during movement
* **Position Hold**

* Locks player position when needed (e.g., hive converting)
* **Safe Cancel / Cleanup**

* Restores humanoid states correctly

### 🛡️ Quality of Life

* **Anti-AFK**
* **Auto Hive Claim**

* Claims an unowned hive automatically
* **Auto Plot Detection**
* **Status Checks**

* Detects pollen, honey, capacity, hive state


🖥️ UI

* **CipexLib UI**
* Clean tabbed interface:

* Farming Tab
* Quest Tab
* Config saving supported

⚙️ Technical

* Uses **ReplicatedStorage remotes safely**
* Thread identity handling for protected calls
* Heartbeat-based movement (smooth + stable)
